name: Groundnut store
schemaNote: See docs/kano.md 3.7 and docs/design.md S2.5 (the room rules). Room x runs 0 to width. No hazards, no pits, no timer. Shelves are stacked groundnut sacks and baskets of kuli-kuli on planks; light comes through two holes in the ceiling. The store keeper, an elder woman, sits on a low stool by the back wall at room x 60 to 100 (look only, no hitbox, never on the walking line). The gift is the groundnut garri parcel (the same shield as the Lagos parcel, decision 18; KN-R11).
